entities.summary: Koyoharu Gotouge  is the pen name of a Japanese manga artist, known for the manga series Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba (2016–2020). By July 2025, the manga had over 220 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.
